summary: Click in the Scene view to stamp grid-snapped blocks for fast level blockouts.
overview: Click in the Scene view, in Edit mode, to stamp grid-snapped blocks. Deliberately NOT a ProBuilder replacement: it stamps whole prefabs and primitives and does not edit meshes — no vertices, faces, extrude or boolean.
useCases: Blocking out a level's shape before any art exists.
Quickly walling off a space to test traversal.
Stamping a repeated prefab on a grid without dragging each one.

gotchas.title: Edit mode only
gotchas.body: It stamps into the scene, which is not something to do in Play mode — the results would be discarded on exit.

gotchas.title: It places, it does not model
gotchas.body: For anything needing a shape that is not a prefab or primitive, this is the wrong tool and ProBuilder is the right one.
